Guide/Tools

Catalog

Grok Bot tools catalog

Catalog from awesome-grok-bot plus later additions: 199 entries — Skills/Plugins/MCP 99, Open-Source Alternatives 67, Tutorials & Guides 33 (CC0, fetched 2026-09-04). High-star self-hosted stacks are compared on alternatives. Each row keeps one-line job + source; check the original repo for license, maintenance, and permissions.

Start with these seven

Compound Engineering

Install in the Cursor marketplace. Grok Bot inherits it. Do not clone onto the Bot computer.

Grok Ship

Scout vs ship. Crewmates drive Cursor cloud agents. Review before any PR.

Vercel plugin

Deployments, logs, domains. Official marketplace plugin Grok Bot can inherit.

gawkbot

Local-first alternative. npx install. Not the official app.

OpenMausBot

Highest-star self-hosted roster plus a VM you run.

Official Linux packages

deb / rpm / AppImage from x.ai/bot first. Community port is fallback only.

grok-bot-cli

Terminal roster and messages. Reuses a signed-in macOS desktop session.

grok-app is not a Grok Bot client. RongleCat/grok-app is a desktop workbench (Tauri) for the local Grok Build CLI.

grokbot-imessage-skill

Read, triage, and send iMessage from the Bot via a local macOS helper.
